title: The Welcome Rain Falling From the Sky
content:
I love Taiwanese artist Kuang-Yu Tsui’s 1997 conceptual art piece The Welcome Rain Falling From the Sky but I couldn’t really tell you what it means. Something about the way people are bombarded with advertisements for consumer goods? I also couldn’t help but think of the iOS game co-created by Neven Mrgan, The Incident.

Tags: art · Kuang-Yu Tsui · video
author: Jason Kottke
